input.command: export DISPLAY=:0; xdotool windowactivate --sync 18874425; sleep 0.5; xdotool getactivewindow getwindowname
export DISPLAY=:0; xdotool windowactivate --sync 18874425; sleep 0.3; xdotool mousemove 932 180; sleep 0.3; xdotool click 1; sleep 1.5; xdotool getactivewindow getwindowname
